exposure: Nusinersen treatment during the third trimester of pregnancy
cohort: A 21-year-old pregnant woman in Poland with SMA who was treated with Nusinersen during the third trimester of pregnancy, and her baby.
finding: Rapid initiation of Nusinersen treatment in a pregnant woman with SMA prevented the loss of her ability to walk and led to a significant improvement in motor function postpartum, with no observed side effects on the mother or negative effects on the fetus.
mod_finding: The pregnancy was ended pre-term at 33 gestational weeks, but no specific mode of birth (vaginal or C-section) or findings related to it for this patient were reported.
